mapper.sql: template_id AS templateId, template_code AS templateCode, template_name AS templateName, description, data_source_id AS dataSourceId, status, current_version_no AS currentVersionNo, version, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime

where.if: AND (template_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR template_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_query_template (template_id, template_code, template_name, description, data_source_id, status, current_version_no, version, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.templateId}, #{row.templateCode}, #{row.templateName}, #{row.description}, #{row.dataSourceId}, #{row.status}, #{row.currentVersionNo}, #{row.version}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.updatedBy}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM t_query_template
ORDER BY update_time DESC, template_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
